lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jason Sanchez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Jason Sanchez is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Jason kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Jason's gone." Sanjay looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jason." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Maha blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jason Sanchez, 41 days. The mantle passes to Maha Qari.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Maha Qari, 50 — a roofer. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Jason — and Jason is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Sanjay, Vikram, Sylvie and 5 more speak for Maha — "Jason trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Maha before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
